mapper.select: WITH candidate AS ( SELECT id FROM cynexus_appl_ai.ai_agent_task WHERE deleted_at IS NULL AND ((status = 'QUEUED' AND schedule_at <= #{now} AND COALESCE(next_attempt_at, schedule_at) <= #{now}) OR (status = 'RUNNING' AND lease_until < #{now})) ORDER BY COALESCE(next_attempt_at, schedule_at), created_at FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED LIMIT #{limit} ) UPDATE cynexus_appl_ai.ai_agent_task task SET status = 'RUNNING', lease_owner = #{workerId}, lease_until = #{leaseUntil}, attempt_count = task.attempt_count + 1, updated_at = now() FROM candidate WHERE task.id = candidate.id RETURNING task.*
mapper.update: UPDATE cynexus_appl_ai.ai_agent_task SET status = 'COMPLETED', run_no = #{runNo}, completed_at = now(), lease_owner = NULL, lease_until = NULL, updated_at = now() WHERE task_no = #{taskNo} AND lease_owner = #{leaseOwner} AND status = 'RUNNING' AND deleted_at IS NULL

UPDATE cynexus_appl_ai.ai_agent_task SET status = 'QUEUED', next_attempt_at = #{nextAttemptAt}, last_error = #{lastError}, lease_owner = NULL, lease_until = NULL, updated_at = now() WHERE task_no = #{taskNo} AND lease_owner = #{leaseOwner} AND status = 'RUNNING' AND deleted_at IS NULL

UPDATE cynexus_appl_ai.ai_agent_task SET status = 'DEAD_LETTER', last_error = #{lastError}, lease_owner = NULL, lease_until = NULL, completed_at = now(), updated_at = now() WHERE task_no = #{taskNo} AND lease_owner = #{leaseOwner} AND status = 'RUNNING' AND deleted_at IS NULL
